about.title: Frontend engineering with a product mindset
about.lead: I turn product requirements into interfaces that are fast, accessible and maintainable — and I document the decisions behind them.

paragraphs.p1: For the past three years I have worked on customer-facing web products: fintech dashboards, booking flows and internal tools. Most of that work is React and Next.js with TypeScript, and most of the value comes from getting the fundamentals right — state that is predictable, forms that validate close to the user, and layouts that survive real content.
paragraphs.p2: I like owning a design system end to end: tokens, components, motion rules, and the documentation that keeps a team from inventing a fifth button style. When the system is solid, feature work becomes assembly instead of archaeology.
paragraphs.p3: Because I ship for Persian-speaking users, RTL is a first-class requirement rather than a late patch — mirrored layouts, localized number and currency formats, and copy that lives in the message catalog instead of being hard-coded in components.

parsAzma.summary: Worked on multiple projects with full frontend ownership.

highlights.h1: Improved Lighthouse Performance from 76 to 98 by resolving LCP and TBT issues.
highlights.h2: Reduced page transfer size from 2.8 MB to 1.9 MB through code splitting, image optimization, and API caching.
highlights.h3: Built an AI-powered chat interface for product discovery, simplifying how users find relevant products.
highlights.h4: Developed a reusable API layer with Axios, React Query, and custom hooks, reducing code duplication.
highlights.h5: Implemented a real-time ticketing chat system with WebSocket, supporting file attachments and notifications.
highlights.h6: Optimized SEO and page performance using Next.js App Router with SSR, SSG, and ISR.
highlights.h7: Collaborated with backend, QA, and design teams and participated in code reviews.
